glossary.definition: (A) "Articulated credit" means post-secondary credit that is reflected on the official record of a student at an institution of higher education only upon enrollment at that institution after graduation from a secondary school.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition:
(B) "Default ceiling amount" means one of the following amounts, whichever is applicable:

(1) For a participant enrolled in a college operating on a semester schedule, the amount calculated according to the following formula:

((0.83 X formula amount) / 30)

X number of enrolled credit hours

(2) For a participant enrolled in a college operating on a quarter schedule, the amount calculated according to the following formula:

((0.83 X formula amount) / 45)

X number of enrolled credit hours
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Default floor amount" means twenty-five per cent of the default ceiling amount.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Eligible out-of-state college" means any institution of higher education that is located outside of Ohio and is approved by the chancellor of higher education to participate in the college credit plus program.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Fee" means any course-related fee and any other fee imposed by the college, but not included in tuition, for participation in the program established by this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Formula amount" means $6,020.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.
Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Home-educated participant" means a student who is exempt from the compulsory attendance law for the purpose of home education under section 3321.042 of the Revised Code, and is participating in the program established by this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition:
(I) "Maximum per participant charge amount" means one of the following amounts, whichever is applicable:

(1) For a participant enrolled in a college operating on a semester schedule, the amount calculated according to the following formula:

((formula amount / 30)

X number of enrolled credit hours)

(2) For a participant enrolled in a college operating on a quarter schedule, the amount calculated according to the following formula:

((formula amount / 45)

X number of enrolled credit hours)
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Nonpublic secondary school" means a chartered school for which minimum standards are prescribed by the director of education and workforce pursuant to division (D) of section 3301.07 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Number of enrolled credit hours" means the number of credit hours for a course in which a participant is enrolled during the previous term after the date on which a withdrawal from a course would have negatively affected the participant's transcripted grade, as prescribed by the college's established withdrawal policy.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Parent" has the same meaning as in section 3313.64 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Participant" means any student enrolled in a college under the program established by this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (N) "Partnering college" means a college with which a public or nonpublic secondary school has entered into an agreement in order to offer the program established by this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (O) "Partnering secondary school" means a public or nonpublic secondary school with which a college has entered into an agreement in order to offer the program established by this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.
Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (Q) "Public college" means a "state institution of higher education" in section 3345.011 of the Revised Code, excluding the northeast Ohio medical university.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (R) "Public secondary school" means a school serving grades nine through twelve in a city, local, or exempted village school district, a joint vocational school district, a community school established under Chapter 3314. of the Revised Code, a STEM school established under Chapter 3326. of the Revised Code, a college-preparatory boarding school established under Chapter 3328. of the Revised Code, the state school for the deaf, the state school for the blind, or an institution operated by the department of youth services.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (S) "School year" has the same meaning as in section 3313.62 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (T) "Secondary grade" means any of grades nine through twelve.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition: (U) "Standard rate" means the amount per credit hour assessed by the college for an in-state student who is enrolled in an undergraduate course at that college, but who is not participating in the college credit plus program, as prescribed by the college's established tuition policy.
glossary.source_title: Section 3365.01 - College Credit Plus program definitions.

glossary.definition:
(V) "Transcripted credit" means post-secondary credit that is conferred by an institution of higher education and is reflected on a student's official record at that institution upon completion of a course.
